content:
Sam: Heads up — thinking rooftop happy hour next Thursday 6:30pm at Station House rooftop? Good way to unwind before EOD. :sun_with_face: :beers:
Jun: love that. Will it be cash bar or can team cover apps? :thinking:
Lena: I'm in if it's accessible (stairs ok?) otherwise I can duck out early. ADA? :wheelchair:
Omar: I can bring a bluetooth speaker and some playlists.
Sam: Accessibility check — rooftop has elevator to rooftop level per venue site. I'll confirm. Also tentative budget: we have ~$200 team social credit left. events-bot can create poll.
snacks-bot: quick survey: "Dietary restrictions?" options: none, vegetarian, vegan, GF, other.
Jun: veg + GF preference for me.
Lena: none.
Omar: none, but bring non-alcoholic options pls.
Sam: RSVP with :thumbsup: = in, :wave: = maybe, :x: = out. Also +1 allowed? say "+1" after emoji.
Jun: :thumbsup: +1
Lena: :wave:
Omar: :thumbsup:
Sam: Great. I'll book a small table and cover apps from team budget. events-bot will make a calendar invite.
events-bot: Event scheduled: "Rooftop Team Happy Hour" Thu May 20 18:30. Guests: Sam, Jun, Lena, Omar. Location: Station House Rooftop 2D https://stationhouse.example/rooftop. Note: table reserved for 1.5 hours.
Sam: Thanks all. I'll DM restaurant re: veg/GF options and post final headcount Wed evening. :calendar:
Jun: Yay! :party_blob:
